long_biography.plain_text:
Seven generations of captains and boat owners gave Ante Ercegovic a maritime inheritance to develop rather than merely preserve. Raised at sea with his father and grandfather, he learned operations and hospitality within the family business before graduating cum laude from the Faculty of Maritime Studies in Split. Engineering work and several years of command then joined formal training with practical responsibility.

Ercegovic used that foundation to help move the family enterprise into custom luxury charter. He contributed to design and build projects, expanded its operating fleet and remained closely involved in crew leadership and guest service. The model combines passenger transport with hospitality: family ownership supports long-term investment, while repeat clients reward consistent delivery. His career therefore reflects active expansion of an inherited platform, with the owner, project developer and captain roles reinforcing one another.
